title: Recipe library
allergyNote: Nothing in the library contains tree nuts or fish. Peanut butter, tortillas, biscuits and bread are normally nut-free, but check labels for a "may contain tree nuts" line if your allergy is strict.
priceNote: Prices are estimates of regular Publix shelf prices at Lakeside Commons in Milledgeville (store 2003) and do not include tax. BOGO and sale prices are checked on publix.com when a week is written.

kits.name: Spicy chicken tortilla soup
kits.blurb: Crock pot chicken soup with jalapeños and smoky chipotle. Becomes lunch bowls, a toppings-bar night and enchiladas.

kits.name: Turkey and sweet potato chili
kits.blurb: A classic crock pot chili. Becomes lunch bowls, chili night for two and chili mac.

kits.name: Crock pot lasagna soup
kits.blurb: All the lasagna flavor with no layering. Becomes lunch bowls, a garlic bread night and a cheesy skillet bake.

kits.name: Creamy chicken pot pie soup
kits.blurb: Cozy crock pot chicken, potatoes and vegetables. Becomes biscuit lunches, a soup night and a biscuit-top pot pie.

kits.name: Tuscan sausage, potato and kale soup
kits.blurb: Hearty and creamy with smoked turkey sausage and white beans. Becomes bread-dunking lunches, a cheesy toast night and a crispy hash.

kits.name: Crock pot BBQ pulled chicken
kits.blurb: Sweet, smoky pulled chicken in a homemade sauce. Becomes slaw bowls, sandwich night for two and quesadillas.

k-tsoup.name: Spicy chicken tortilla soup

ingredients.qty: 2 peppers, minced, plus 1 tbsp of the sauce

steps: Lay the chicken breasts in the crock pot.
Pile on the sweet potato, diced onion, minced garlic, diced jalapeños, the 2 minced chipotles with 1 tbsp of their adobo sauce, the rinsed black beans and the diced tomatoes.
Pour in 5 cups of broth. Sprinkle over 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano and 1½ tsp salt, and stir around the chicken.
Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours or high 4 hours.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and stir it back in with 1½ cups of corn and the juice of 2 limes. Cook 15 minutes more.
Taste. For more heat, stir in another spoon of the adobo sauce. Keep 4 bowls in the fridge and freeze the rest in single bowls.
k-tsoup.tip: Freeze the leftover chipotles flat in a bag for later.

k-tsoup-lunch.name: Tortilla soup lunch bowl
steps: Spray the tortilla strips with cooking spray and air-fry at 380°F for 5 minutes until crunchy.
Microwave the bowl of tortilla soup for 3 minutes, stirring halfway. From frozen, thaw it in the fridge the night before.
Top with 2 tbsp cheese, a few jalapeño slices, a spoonful of yogurt, a squeeze of lime and the tortilla strips.

k-tsoup-night.name: Tortilla soup night with a toppings bar
steps: Warm 2 bowls of tortilla soup in a pot over medium heat.
Spray the tortilla strips with cooking spray and air-fry at 380°F for 5 to 6 minutes until crunchy.
Set out the diced avocado, cheese, yogurt, sliced jalapeño, chopped cilantro, lime wedges and tortilla strips so everyone tops their own.
k-tsoup-night.tip: Fresh jalapeño on the side lets each person pick their heat.

k-tsoup-enchiladas.name: Tortilla soup chicken enchiladas
k-tsoup-enchiladas.equip: small baking dish, air fryer or oven
steps: Spoon the chicken, beans and sweet potato out of the bowl of tortilla soup with a slotted spoon. Keep the broth in a cup.
Microwave the 4 tortillas under a damp towel for 30 seconds so they roll without cracking.
Fill each tortilla, roll it and set it seam down in a small baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Stir the soup broth into ⅓ cup salsa, pour it over and top with ⅓ cup cheese.
Air-fry at 375°F for 8 minutes (or bake at 400°F for 15) until bubbly. Top with the sliced avocado and green onion.

k-chili.name: Turkey and sweet potato chili
steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Brown the ground turkey with the diced onion for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Scrape the turkey and onion into the crock pot. Add the minced garlic, sweet potato cubes, rinsed black beans and kidney beans, the diced tomatoes and 1½ cups of broth.
Stir in 2 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano and 1½ tsp salt.
Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours or high 4 hours, until the sweet potato is tender.
Keep 4 bowls in the fridge and freeze the rest in single bowls.

k-chili-lunch.name: Turkey chili lunch bowl
steps: Microwave the bowl of turkey chili for 3 minutes, stirring halfway. From frozen, thaw it in the fridge the night before.
Top with 2 tbsp cheese, sliced green onion and a spoonful of yogurt.

k-chili-night.name: Chili night with a toppings bar
steps: Warm 2 bowls of turkey chili in a pot over medium heat.
Spray the tortilla strips with cooking spray and air-fry at 380°F for 5 to 6 minutes until crunchy.
Set out the cheese, yogurt, sliced green onion, chopped cilantro and tortilla strips so everyone tops their own.

k-chili-mac.name: Turkey chili mac
steps: Boil 3 oz macaroni in well-salted water for 7 minutes and drain.
Stir the bowl of turkey chili into the macaroni and warm through over medium heat.
Fold in ¼ cup cheese until melty and top with sliced green onion.

k-lasagna.name: Crock pot lasagna soup
steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Brown the ground turkey with the diced onion for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Scrape it into the crock pot with the minced garlic, crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes and 4 cups of broth.
Stir in 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp red pepper flakes, 1½ tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper.
Cover and cook on low 6 to 7 hours or high 3 to 4 hours.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts. Keep 4 bowls in the fridge and freeze the rest in single bowls. Cook the pasta fresh with each meal so it never goes soggy.

k-lasagna-lunch.name: Lasagna soup bowl
steps: Boil 2 oz penne in well-salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Microwave the bowl of lasagna soup for 3 minutes, stirring halfway. From frozen, thaw it in the fridge the night before.
Stir in the penne and top with 2 tbsp ricotta and 2 tbsp mozzarella.

k-lasagna-night.name: Lasagna soup night with garlic bread
steps: Boil 4 oz penne in well-salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Warm 2 bowls of lasagna soup in a pot over medium heat and stir in the penne.
Brush the bread slices with 1 tbsp olive oil and toast at 400°F for 5 minutes. Rub each slice with the cut garlic clove.
Ladle the soup into bowls and top each with 2 tbsp ricotta, 2 tbsp mozzarella and 1 tbsp parmesan. Serve with the garlic bread.

k-lasagna-bake.name: Skillet lasagna bake
k-lasagna-bake.equip: oven-safe skillet or small baking dish
steps: Heat the oven or air fryer to 400°F. Boil 3 oz penne in well-salted water for 8 minutes, a little firm, and drain.
Simmer the bowl of lasagna soup in a small oven-safe skillet for 5 minutes to thicken, then stir in the penne.
Dot with ¼ cup ricotta and scatter over ⅓ cup mozzarella and 1 tbsp parmesan.
Bake 10 minutes until the cheese bubbles and browns.

k-potpie.name: Creamy chicken pot pie soup
steps: Lay the chicken breasts in the crock pot and add the halved potatoes, sliced carrots, sliced celery, diced onion and minced garlic.
Pour in 4 cups of broth and add 1 tsp dried thyme, 1½ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper and 1 bay leaf.
Cover and cook on low 7 hours or high 4 hours.
Lift out the chicken and shred it. Remove and discard the bay leaf.
Whisk 3 tbsp cornstarch into 1 cup of milk until smooth. Stir it into the crock pot with the shredded chicken and 1½ cups of frozen peas and carrots.
Cover and cook on high 20 minutes more, until thick and creamy. Keep 4 bowls in the fridge and freeze the rest in single bowls.

k-potpie-lunch.name: Pot pie soup with a warm biscuit
steps: Air-fry 1 biscuit at 330°F for 9 to 10 minutes until golden.
Microwave the bowl of pot pie soup for 3 minutes, stirring halfway. From frozen, thaw it in the fridge the night before.
Finish with a crack of black pepper and dunk the biscuit.

k-potpie-night.name: Pot pie soup night with biscuits and green beans
steps: Air-fry the 4 biscuits at 330°F for 9 to 10 minutes until golden.
Warm 2 bowls of pot pie soup in a pot over medium heat.
Sear the green beans in 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over high heat for 5 minutes. Finish with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the soup with the biscuits and green beans on the side.

k-potpie-skillet.name: Biscuit-top chicken pot pie
k-potpie-skillet.equip: small baking dish, air fryer or oven
steps: Heat the oven or air fryer to 350°F.
Simmer the bowl of pot pie soup in a small pot for 5 minutes. Whisk 1 tsp cornstarch with 1 tbsp water, stir it in and cook 1 minute until it thickens like pie filling.
Pour it into a small baking dish coated with cooking spray and set the 2 biscuits on top.
Bake 14 to 16 minutes until the biscuits are golden and cooked through.

k-tuscan.name: Tuscan sausage, potato and kale soup
steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Brown the sliced sausage with the diced onion for 5 minutes.
Scrape it into the crock pot with the quartered potatoes, rinsed cannellini beans, minced garlic and 6 cups of broth.
Stir in 2 tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper.
Cover and cook on low 6 to 7 hours or high 3 to 4 hours, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the kale, 1 cup of milk and ¼ cup parmesan. Cover and cook 15 minutes more on high until the kale is soft.
Keep 4 bowls in the fridge and freeze the rest in single bowls.

k-tuscan-lunch.name: Tuscan soup with crusty bread
steps: Microwave the bowl of Tuscan soup for 3 minutes, stirring halfway. From frozen, thaw it in the fridge the night before.
Top with 1 tbsp parmesan and a pinch of red pepper flakes, and serve with the slice of bread for dunking.

k-tuscan-night.name: Tuscan soup night with cheesy toast
steps: Warm 2 bowls of Tuscan soup in a pot over medium heat.
Brush the bread slices with 1 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with ¼ tsp garlic powder and top with ⅓ cup mozzarella.
Toast at 400°F for 5 to 6 minutes until the cheese melts.
Ladle the soup into bowls, scatter 1 tbsp parmesan over each and serve with the cheesy toast.

k-tuscan-hash.name: Sausage, potato and kale hash with eggs
steps: Spoon the sausage, potatoes and beans out of the bowl of Tuscan soup with a slotted spoon. Save the broth for another day.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and crisp the sausage, potatoes and beans for 6 minutes, pressing them flat.
Toss in a handful of kale for 1 minute, then make two wells and crack in the 2 eggs.
Cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes until the whites set. Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper.

k-bbq.name: Crock pot BBQ pulled chicken
steps: Whisk 1 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp yellow mustard, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper in the crock pot. This is the BBQ sauce.
Scatter in the sliced onion, lay the chicken breasts on top and turn them to coat.
Cover and cook on low 6 hours or high 3 hours.
Shred the chicken with two forks right in the sauce. Keep 4 portions in the fridge and freeze the rest in single portions.
k-bbq.tip: Homemade sauce, so you know exactly what is in it. Many bottled BBQ sauces hide ingredients you avoid.

k-bbq-lunch.name: BBQ chicken bowl with crunchy slaw
steps: Stir 2 tbsp yogurt, 1 tsp apple cider vinegar and a pinch of salt into the coleslaw mix.
Microwave the BBQ chicken portion with the rice and ¼ cup corn for 2 minutes. From frozen, thaw the chicken in the fridge the night before.
Pile the slaw on top.
k-bbq-lunch.tip: Cook a pot of jasmine rice on Sunday for the week.

k-bbq-night.name: Pulled chicken sandwiches with slaw
steps: Warm 2 portions of BBQ chicken in a skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Stir ¼ cup yogurt, 2 tsp apple cider vinegar, a pinch of salt and a pinch of black pepper into the coleslaw mix.
Toast the buns cut side down in a dry pan for 1 minute.
Pile the chicken on the buns and top with slaw and pickles.

k-bbq-quesadilla.name: BBQ chicken quesadillas
steps: Lay the 2 tortillas flat. Cover half of each with ¼ cup cheddar, the BBQ chicken and the sliced red onion, then fold.
Coat a skillet with cooking spray and cook the quesadillas over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted.
Cut in wedges and scatter over the cilantro.

spinach-feta-wrap.name: Spinach and feta egg wrap
steps: Coat a skillet with cooking spray and wilt the spinach over medium heat for 1 minute.
Whisk the 3 eggs with a pinch of salt and black pepper, pour them over the spinach and scramble gently until just set.
Warm the tortilla in the empty pan for 20 seconds, fill it with the eggs, 2 tbsp feta and 2 tbsp salsa, and roll it up.

pb-yogurt-bowl.name: Peanut butter banana yogurt bowl
steps: Spoon 1 cup yogurt into a bowl and top with the sliced banana.
Warm 1 tbsp peanut butter in the microwave for 10 seconds and drizzle it over with 1 tsp honey.
Finish with 2 tbsp oats and a pinch of cinnamon for crunch.
pb-yogurt-bowl.tip: No granola, since most of it is made with tree nuts.

banana-pancakes.name: Banana oat blender pancakes
steps: Blend ½ cup oats, the banana, 2 eggs, ¼ cup yogurt and ½ tsp cinnamon until smooth. Rest 3 minutes.
Coat a skillet with cooking spray over medium heat and pour in small pancakes, about 3 tbsp each.
Cook 2 minutes until bubbles form, flip and cook 1 minute more.
Top with the thawed berries.

sausage-egg-muffin.name: Turkey sausage egg muffin sandwiches
steps: Toast the English muffins.
Coat a skillet with cooking spray and cook the 2 sausage patties over medium heat for 3 minutes a side.
Fry the 2 eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, for 2 minutes. Season with black pepper.
Stack each muffin with a sausage patty, an egg and a slice of cheddar.

turkey-lettuce-tacos.name: Turkey taco lettuce wraps
steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and brown the ground turkey for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, ½ tsp garlic powder, ¾ tsp salt and 3 tbsp water. Simmer 2 minutes.
Spoon the turkey into the lettuce leaves and top with salsa, cheese, diced avocado and a squeeze of lime.
turkey-lettuce-tacos.tip: Good as a dinner for two.

lemon-chicken-pasta.name: Lemon garlic chicken pasta with spinach

ingredients.qty: 1 tsp plus more for the water

steps: Boil 8 oz spaghetti in well-salted water. Save 1 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Season the chicken with 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper. Sear it in 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high for 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, the sliced garlic and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Toss in the spinach until it wilts, then the spaghetti, the lemon zest and juice, ⅓ cup parmesan and splashes of pasta water until glossy.

beef-broccoli.name: Beef and broccoli with rice
steps: Cook 1 cup rice with 1½ cups water, covered, for 15 minutes.
Whisk ¼ cup soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp cornstarch, the minced garlic, grated ginger and ¼ cup water. Toss the sliced steak in 2 tbsp of it.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over high and sear the steak in one layer for 2 minutes. Move it to a plate.
Add the broccoli and 3 tbsp water, cover and steam 3 minutes.
Return the steak, pour in the rest of the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy. Finish with 1 tsp sesame oil and the green onion and serve over the rice.

turkey-burger-bowl.name: Turkey burger bowls with crispy potatoes
steps: Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and ½ tsp salt. Air-fry at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes, shaking halfway.
Brown the ground turkey in a skillet over medium-high for 6 minutes with ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper.
Stir ¼ cup yogurt, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp yellow mustard and 1 tbsp of the chopped pickles together for burger sauce.
Build bowls of romaine, turkey, potatoes, cherry tomatoes, diced red onion, the rest of the pickles and cheddar, and spoon over the sauce.

sausage-sheet-pan.name: Sheet-pan sausage, potatoes and green beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the halved potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp smoked paprika and roast 15 minutes.
Toss the sausage coins and green beans with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper.
Add them to the pan and roast 15 minutes more, until the potatoes are crisp.
Serve with Dijon mustard for dipping.

chicken-fried-rice.name: Chicken fried rice
steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over high. Season the chicken with a pinch of salt and cook 5 minutes until browned.
Add the minced garlic, the frozen peas and carrots and the white parts of the green onion for 2 minutes.
Push everything aside, scramble the 2 eggs in the space, then add the cold rice and press it flat to crisp for 2 minutes.
Toss with 3 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil and top with the green onion tops.

buffalo-wraps.name: Buffalo chicken wraps
steps: Season the chicken strips with ½ tsp garlic powder and ½ tsp salt. Cook in 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high for 6 minutes.
Turn off the heat and toss the chicken in ¼ cup hot sauce.
Stir ⅓ cup yogurt, ½ tsp dried dill and ¼ tsp garlic powder for a cool dip.
Fill each tortilla with romaine, sliced celery, the chicken, 2 tbsp cheddar and a spoon of the dip, then roll up tight.
buffalo-wraps.tip: Plain cayenne hot sauce is just peppers, vinegar, salt and garlic. Check the label all the same.

honey-garlic-thighs.name: Honey garlic chicken thighs with green beans
steps: Cook 1 cup rice with 1½ cups water, covered, for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken thighs with ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high, 5 minutes a side.
Stir together 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, the minced garlic and a pinch of red pepper flakes. Pour it over the chicken and simmer 3 minutes, turning, until sticky.
Move the chicken to plates. Toss the green beans in the pan sauce with 2 tbsp water, cover and steam 4 minutes. Serve everything over the rice.

turkey-meatball-subs.name: Turkey meatball subs
steps: Mix the ground turkey, ⅓ cup panko, the egg, 2 tbsp parmesan, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp garlic powder and ½ tsp salt. Roll into 16 meatballs.
Coat the air fryer basket with cooking spray and air-fry the meatballs at 380°F for 10 to 12 minutes.
Warm 1½ cups marinara in a small pot and roll the meatballs in it.
Fill the 4 hoagie rolls with meatballs, top with ½ cup mozzarella and air-fry 2 minutes to melt.

sweet-potato-tacos.name: Black bean and sweet potato tacos
steps: Toss the sweet potato cubes with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp chili powder, ½ tsp ground cumin and ½ tsp salt. Air-fry at 400°F for 15 minutes, shaking once.
Warm the rinsed black beans in a small pot with ½ tsp ground cumin, ¼ tsp salt and 2 tbsp water, mashing a few.
Warm the 6 tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with beans and sweet potato, then top with the sliced avocado, cheese, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

greek-chicken-pitas.name: Greek chicken pitas
steps: Toss the chicken strips with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the lemon juice, 1 grated garlic clove, 2 tsp dried oregano and ¾ tsp salt.
Sear in a skillet over medium-high for 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through.
Stir ¾ cup yogurt with the other grated garlic clove, 1 tsp dried dill, the rest of the lemon juice, ¼ tsp salt and 2 tbsp of the diced cucumber.
Warm the pitas, then fill them with chicken, the rest of the cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, feta and the yogurt sauce.

peanut-chicken-noodles.name: Peanut chicken noodles with crunchy slaw
steps: Boil 6 oz spaghetti in salted water, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk 3 tbsp peanut butter, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, the lime juice, the grated garlic, 1 tsp sesame oil, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes and 3 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Cook the chicken strips in 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high for 5 to 6 minutes.
Toss the spaghetti, chicken and coleslaw mix with the peanut sauce and top with the green onion. Good warm or cold.
peanut-chicken-noodles.tip: Peanuts are fine for you. Check the peanut butter label for a "may contain tree nuts" line.

turkey-stuffed-peppers.name: Turkey stuffed peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Set the pepper halves cut side up in a baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Brown the ground turkey in a skillet for 6 minutes with 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, ½ tsp onion powder and ¾ tsp salt.
Stir in the rice and the fire-roasted tomatoes and simmer 3 minutes.
Pack the filling into the peppers, cover with foil and bake 20 minutes. Uncover, top with ½ cup cheese and bake 5 minutes more.

beef-taco-skillet.name: Beef taco rice skillet
steps: Brown the ground beef in a deep skillet over medium-high for 5 minutes and pour off any fat.
Stir in 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin and ½ tsp salt for 30 seconds.
Add ¾ cup rice, 1½ cups broth, 1 cup salsa, the rinsed black beans and ¾ cup corn. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Scatter ½ cup cheese over the top, cover 2 minutes to melt and finish with the green onion.
